scope: bounded standalone native ARM userspace library workload; no installed app or production DB replacement
binary_identity_note: 50k transfers SHA256-verified by private runner; earlier 1k/10k transfers verified but their after binary digest was not separately retained
cache_note: OS cache uncontrolled; open timings are warm reopen including quick_check, not cold boot
layout_note: 1k/10k files and DB on Y2DATA; 50k split 25k DATA + 25k SD, all SQLite DBs on Y2DATA; prune operates roughly 1% of the first source (25k at largest)
query_plan_note: prune_legacy is an unchanged diagnostic plan; optimized temp presence/keyset expectations are asserted in platform_tests
safety: flock /tmp/y2-platform-v1-device.lock; fresh 0700 pinned scratch; bytes/inodes/reserve admitted; same boot/taint0/exact mount generation verified each run; own scratch and temporary binaries cleaned; no flash/push
